messages:
maya: FYI reproducible multi-node TP runs are hitting rendezvous timeouts after yesterday's kernel-selector + batching heuristic change. Seen on 8-node perf farm.
jon: Timeout or hard hang? can you paste the root error line?
maya: Timeout: "rendezvous: rank 3 did not respond within 120s" then worker sits in allreduce. Perf trace points to NCCL stall. Also noticed KV cache hit rate dropped a lot after the change.
sasha: :eyes: which knobs changed exactly? kernel variant + batching behavior?
maya: Both. Kernel selector now prefers matmul_opt_v2 for many ops; auto-batcher is choosing much larger micro-batches. Quick snippets:
```
kernel_selector: choose=matmul_opt_v2
batcher: target_micro_batch=8 -> 32
kvcache: hits=41% misses=59%
```
jon: yikes. larger micro-batches can blow up allreduce payloads. do we have allreduce sizes/timings?
maya: p95 token latency ~2x. allreduce per-step bytes jumped ~1.2GB (was ~300MB). NCCL timeline shows long pairwise stalls. Repro command: `./run_tp_test.sh --nodes 8 --tp 2 --batcher=auto --kernel=auto --trace=on`
alex: @maya can you try forcing kernel=matmul_opt_v1 and cap micro-batch to 8 to isolate? quick test.
maya: tried forcing kernel=v1 -> still eventually times out but later in the run. forcing batcher cap back to 8 makes the job stable. so batcher expansion is the proximate trigger.
jon: that implicates the batching heuristic. curious about KV cache drop — does bigger micro-batch pattern cause more evictions? any kvcache mem pressure logs?
maya: yes, mem_pressure spikes when micro-batches grow and we start evicting hot segments. Evict logs show: `kvcache: capacity=24GB used=23.6GB evicted=112 segments` and evicted keys include `global_ln_12` repeated.
lee: can we change kvcache policy (LRU -> segmented) or add guard when usage > 80%? also need prefix-reuse distribution to verify.
sasha: perf-ci reran a controlled test with two variants: (1) keep kernel v2 but cap micro-batch=8, (2) keep micro-batch auto but revert kernel -> only variant (1) is stable. results: p50 improves, p95 back down. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/perf/4821
perf-ci: [build/4821] TP scaling perf test - flaky -> https://ci.internal/redwood/4821 :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: network counters show small burst packet drops on node-3 coincident with timeout window. drops <0.1% but at >1GB allreduce that might amplify NCCL backoffs.
alex: plan: 1) revert or gate the aggressive micro-batching heuristic, 2) add a safety cap if kvcache usage > 80%, 3) add comm/compute overlap traces and kvcache eviction metric to runtime dashboard. roll forward after telemetry proves stable.
maya: I'll open a PR to gate the heuristic and push kvcache metrics + dashboard panels. assigning reviewers @jon @sasha. ETA EOD.
jon: please attach flamegraph + NCCL timestamps in the PR so we can eyeball overlap.
maya: attaching minimal flame ascii and NCCL timeline snippet in the PR, plus the run command and a short reproducer log.
sasha: thanks — once PR is up we should also run a stress matrix (nodes 4/8/16) and vary micro-batch cap at 4/8/16 to validate safety caps.
maya: Agreed. I'll kick off matrix after PR lands. :white_check_mark:
